name: Demilich Skull AP OLD
description: The skull of a defeated demilich is haunted by souls of the demilich's victims.
disable: DC 26 Arcana , DC 26 Occultism , DC 26 Nature , or DC 26 Religion to counteract the skull's Broken Gems

generalAbilities.name: Broken Gems
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the skull

Effect The spirits haunting the skull activate one of the skull's ruined gemstones, casting one of the following four spells determined randomly:

  • Cast into Time, Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw
  • Chain Lightning, Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw (8d12 Electricity Damage damage)
  • Fireball (6th), Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw (12d6 Fire Damage damage)
  • Spellwrack, Basic DC 26 Will Saving Throw (2d12 Persistent,force Damage or (2*2d12) Persistent,force Damage damage)

The saving throw DC for any spell is 26.
